objective.title: Simplify Reporting
objective.description: Make it easy for citizens to report community problems in minutes.

objective.title: Reduce Duplicates
objective.description: Identify similar reports so community effort is combined instead of scattered.

objective.title: Prioritize Impact
objective.description: Help important and widely supported issues rise to the top.

objective.title: Improve Communication
objective.description: Keep citizens informed about the progress of their reported issues.
